propositions: Agent behavior shows repeated use of rebar review-plan --force on blocked tickets, defeating the plan-review gate's claimability fast-fail despite individual reviews being plausible.
SKILL.md lacks explicit documentation that a blocked ticket status is a successful terminal state of the review cycle and requires no further agent action.
The skill does not warn agents against using --force flag or clarify that --force is a human-operator-only escape hatch, not an agent move.
Policy reinforcement to SKILL.md must state blocked/not-yet-claimable tickets complete the review cycle successfully and re-enter via rebar ready when blockers close.

Policy reinforcement must prohibit --force as an agent move and direct agents to ask a clarifying question before forcing, explaining that forced reviews mint stale attestations against non-final dependencies.
